caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: The bar chart titled “Fluency” displays the performance of four different prompt variants—labeled V1, V2, V3, and V4—of the HDM model on the fluency dimension, as evaluated by the GEMBA-SQM metric. The vertical y-axis represents the fluency score, ranging from 97.0 to 100.0 in increments of 0.5, with horizontal gridlines aiding visual alignment. Each variant is represented by a distinct colored bar: V1 (dark blue) achieves the highest fluency score at 99.15, followed by V3 (green) at 98.5, V2 (orange) at 98.2, and V4 (purple) at 97.7. The bars are arranged in descending order of performance from left to right, with V1 being the tallest and V4 the shortest, visually emphasizing the relative fluency ranking across the four prompts. The chart illustrates that V1 outperforms the others in fluency, while V4 lags behind, with all scores falling within a narrow range between 97.7 and 99.15.
